title: platform-objects/ui: `options` declared on a text field is honoured by analytics dimension labels and grid grouping but not by the text cell, so one declaration reads two ways
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① the finding the director's ruling on #27855 (comment 6556744206, letter C, maintainer 「28590 27855 同意」 2026-11-01T10:29Z) carries to the server seat for the enforce-or-remove channel. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. Graded by this seat: p3 (no shipped object is known to rely on the split; a display inconsistency, not a wrong stored value), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: any author who declares `options` on a `text` field (the spec allows `options` on every field type).
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/lint` or the console text cell under `ui/`, depending on the route chosen).

## What happens (read, not measured)

- Analytics resolves a dimension's display label from a declared non-empty `options` list on ANY field type, deliberately (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts`, header lines 9–16: "the condition is the declared list itself, never the field's type").
- Grid grouping reads the same list for its group headers (per the ruling's reading).
- The text cell renders the stored value and ignores `options`.

So a text field with `options` shows `backlog` in its cell and `Backlog` in a chart or group header. The declaration is honoured at two faces and silently ignored at the third.

## Wanted (enforce or remove; the route is the dispatching seat's)

Either:
- **enforce:** the text cell renders the matching option label when the field declares `options` (stored value untouched; unmatched values render as themselves), or
- **remove:** authoring refuses or warns on `options` declared on a type whose main face does not read them, with the analytics and grouping faces left as they are or aligned.

Measure first: how many shipped objects (`packages/platform-objects`, `examples/**`, platform apps) declare `options` on a `text` field. The #27855 ruling chose NOT to add display-only `options` to `sys_notification.topic`, so that field is not a reason to enforce.

Dedupe: searched `options text field label` and `options "text field" dimension`; closed #18923 is the dimension-labels header wording only. **New.**

Links back: #27855 (ruling 6556744206), #28105.
